description: Center-of-mass displacement: distance from the embedded-conformer CoM to the Vina box center, across the candidate pool. Diagnostic for whether the pool's geometry sits near the pocket.
source: RDKit ETKDGv3 embed + UFFOptimizeMolecule (maxIters=200); CoM from heavy atoms only; box center = co-crystal ligand centroid at [-0.736, 22.755473684210525, -31.236894736842107].

value.note: CoM displacement of the embedded conformation from the Vina box center (larger = the embedded geometry sits far from the box center before docking).
